meta.description: Gain and read noise measured at the OST on bias and flat pairs (reduce.detector_noise.measure_detector_noise). Used when the header does not name the camera's readout mode, e.g. MaxIm DL frames whose READOUTM ('Fast' / 'Normal') is MaxIm's exposure-tab setting and not the QHY driver mode.

sources: T CrB 2024-06 (READOUTM Fast bin 1, 40 bias, 293 flats; Normal bin 2, 80 bias, 2200 flats)
ATO J080.5805+10.6719 (Fast bin 2, dark pairs, 20 flats)
qhy600m.note: Read noise per native pixel 5.6-5.8 e-, consistent with the 2CMS modes only; gain 15 % below the manufacturer curves (1.52).

sources: HAT-P-20 (READOUTM Normal bin 3, dark pairs, 40 flats)
qhy600m.note: Bin 3 read noise is not 3x the native value (not a plain 3x3 sum).
